'''Kyoko Hikami''' (Japanese: '''氷上恭子''' ''Hikami Kyōko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

== Biography ==
Hikami was born on January 11, 1969 in {{wp|Kobe}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. Hikami has provided a few voices for {{aniseries|PTS}} since the {{aniseries|OS}}. Her most prominent role is that of [[Erika]], the [[Celadon City]] [[Gym Leader]], which she later reprised in ''[[JN094|Suffering the Flings and Arrows!]]''. She is currently affiliated with the talent management agency {{wp|Mausu Promotion}}.
